jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.164.0 to 1.165.0. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.164.0 to 1.165.0. In README.md change every 1.164.0 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.165.0. In these tests replace the 1.164.0 pin with 1.165.0 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.165.0 above the 1.164.0 entry (keep the 1.164.0 entry unchanged) with the lead-in line: Resolved blockers never return, generated files never dirty the tree, and the update restarts servers safely. And these bullets: Autopilot: a resolved blocker is never raised again for the same run; smoke, lane-test and probe runs never raise complete-but-not-integrated blockers; under-filled waves are batched into one wave. | Generated state files (HANDOFF, usage ledger, build plan, .swarm) never count as a dirty tree; HANDOFF regenerates only on real change and lists pending approvals from every worktree. | integrate commits its own verified output on swarm branches; per-branch integration lock; policy commit windows for generated files; ignoreTestsReason job field; machine-wide budget raise request. | The runner version pointer lives in an untracked local file; hook paths always point at current; reason words never trip the hand-build guard; a pinned version reports its own version. | swarm update restarts the board and remote servers (SIGTERM, identity-checked), swarm update --when-idle, swarm forget, scratch projects never reach the owner inbox, commit-msg guard for manifest commits. (one bullet per | separated item, bold lead word like the 1.164.0 entry). Change nothing else. Run the six listed test files; all must pass. ignoreTests reason: only version pins and the changelog change; the fixture ledger is a frozen data copy.
